## About

I am a researcher (*chargé de recherches*) at the [Institut national d'études démographiques (INED)](https://www.ined.fr), based in Aubervilliers, France. As an economist and demographer, my research focuses on **mortality, spatial inequalities, and the long-run dynamics of demographic divergence**.

I am co-director of the [French Regional Database](https://frdb.site.ined.fr) and an elected member of INED's board of directors.

## Currently working on

- **Deaths of despair in Europe** — manuscript under review at *The Lancet Public Health* (with Pavel Grigoriev, BiB Wiesbaden)
- **ANR SPLIT** — Spatial Polarization of Longevity in Post-Pandemic Europe (PI, with German PI Pavel Grigoriev)
- **ERC Redim, ANR Worth-IT, ANR Socface, COST "The Great Leap"** — collaborative projects on regional demographic dynamics
- **Decoding 1950–1967 French mortality data** — historical VAX F_floating binary files from Vallin & Meslé (INED, 1988)
